purpose: Teach: 農協/アポ/故に/計り/交差/つかめ/生後/下流

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地元農協との取引、強化しろ。
lines.en: Strengthen our partnership with the local farm cooperative.
lines.style: Direct command. Clipped consonants, no waste. Weight on the verb. Eyes steady on Kenji, expecting compliance. Matter-of-fact authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員アポ、来週、取りました。
lines.en: Yes. I've scheduled executive appointments for next week.
lines.style: Efficient, slightly clipped. Crisp delivery of facts. Lean forward slightly—showing readiness. No embellishment, just results.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 長年の信頼、故に契約、続けてくれている。
lines.en: We've built this on years of trust. That's why they keep renewing.
lines.style: Measured, almost teaching. Slight pause before 'hence.' Voice carries quiet gravity—this is not just logistics, it's relationship. Slower pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コスト、計りに掛けて、絞り込みます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll analyze costs carefully and cut what doesn't serve us.
lines.style: Brisk, analytical tone. Nod on the opening. Quick rhythm but not rushed—showing he's already thinking through the work ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 交差点での広告、効果、上がってきた。
lines.en: The intersection advertising is starting to gain real traction.
lines.style: Slight lift in tone—quiet satisfaction without self-congratulation. Slower on the opening word. Weight on 'rising.' A moment to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規市場、つかめない時期、過ぎました。
lines.en: Yes. We've moved past that period when new markets were out of reach.
lines.style: Warmer tone, light upward inflection. Forward momentum in the delivery. Slight smile in the voice—this is progress they both see.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業生後、すぐに広がった伝説、皆に伝えろ。
lines.en: The legend that grew so quickly after we started—make sure everyone knows it.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'legend'—there's pride here beneath the command. Wants this story carried. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。流通の下流、整備、急ぎます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll prioritize getting the downstream distribution channels organized.
lines.style: Tight, efficient. Clipped ending on 'channels'—showing urgency without panic. Lean slightly forward. Already moving to action.
